paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the percentage of in-context example pool and the minimum FDE20 value for two different methods. The x-axis represents the percentage of in-context example pool, ranging from 0 to 1.0 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents the minimum FDE20 value, ranging from 22 to 30 with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot contains two lines: the blue line with circular markers represents TrajICL, and the orange line with circular markers represents Full FT. The blue line starts at approximately 23.2 when the percentage of in-context example pool is 0.1, decreases to around 22.8 at 0.3, and continues to decline to about 21.1 when the percentage reaches 1.0. The orange line begins at around 30.5 when the percentage of in-context example pool is 0.1, decreases to approximately 27.4 at 0.2, and then remains relatively stable until 0.5, after which it declines to about 25.5 when the percentage reaches 1.0.
